verdict.line: You lose trades if you eat free Parrrley pokes before level 6, but you win the lane once Toxic Shot ticks and mushroom zoning take over from level 9 on.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) outranges your melee trade pattern at 625 range on a 5s cooldown, and his passive Grog-Soaked Blade adds free poison on every auto he lands, so short trades favor him before your poison stacks catch up. Your real leverage is attrition: once E (Toxic Shot) is ticking on every auto and R (Noxious Trap) mushrooms deny his approach angles, the lane becomes a stalemate his all-in can't force through Remove Scurvy alone.

theirWindow.what: He pokes from 625 range with Parrrley plus auto poison before you can answer; don't push to last-hit inside his range while his Q is up, since one poke plus Grog-Soaked Blade outpaces your regen.

yourWindow.when: Blinding Dart up, he's in melee range
yourWindow.what: Hit Q (Blinding Dart) the instant he commits to an auto in melee; the blind cancels that auto and the poison tick with it, turning his engage into a free hit for you.

start.why: 49.3% win rate over 1686 games at 72.5% pick; the mana and sustain let you spam Toxic Shot pokes and absorb Parrrley chip damage without losing lane presence.

boots.why: 50.2% win rate over 990 games at 45.1% pick; magic pen scales your on-hit poison damage since Gangplank has no early magic resist to answer it.

core.why: Attack speed and on-hit proc stack Toxic Shot ticks faster, part of the 51.2% win rate path over 639 games.
Burn damage compounds with your poison DoT for sustained trade damage, the second step of the 41.4%-pick build order.
Caps the core path at 51.2% win rate; the cooldown reduction lets you reset Blinding Dart faster in extended skirmishes.

situational.when: you need more consistent kiting to dodge his Q poke and his Cannon Barrage zone
you're already ahead and want to burst through his Remove Scurvy heal before it's back up
the game runs long and you want maximum poison tick damage
you want extra attack speed to stack Toxic Shot faster in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive autos right after a blind shuts down his return trade, amplifying the free-hit window Blinding Dart creates.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 92.6% of games at 48.9% win rate; Ignite's damage over time punishes his all-ins since Remove Scurvy only clears CC and heals, it doesn't stop the burn once it's ticking.

playing.title: Freeze under Parrrley range
playing.detail: Hold position just outside 625 range before level 6; every Parrrley you eat also triggers Grog-Soaked Blade poison on the follow-up auto, so free pokes compound fast.

playing.title: Blind before he autos
playing.detail: Fire Q (Blinding Dart) the moment he steps into melee range to trade; it cancels his auto and its poison tick, converting his engage into a free hit for you.

playing.title: Use Move Quick to dodge
playing.detail: Keep W (Move Quick) active for the passive speed boost so you can sidestep Parrrley casts and reposition out of his range without taking chip damage.

playing.title: Zone jungle entrances with traps
playing.detail: Drop R (Noxious Trap) mushrooms near jungle entrances and your lane bush; stepping on one slows and deals damage over time, discouraging his roams and dive attempts.

playing.title: Don't facecheck brushes blind
playing.detail: His poke is ranged and stacks fast, so avoid walking into brush without vision; use your own Camouflage passive by standing still to set up ambushes instead.

playing.title: Punish his Remove Scurvy cooldown
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy) sits on an 18-22s cooldown by rank; once he burns it to cleanse a slow or heal through poison, chain your next Blinding Dart or trap engage immediately after.

playing.title: Time kills around Ignite
playing.detail: Your kill pressure comes from stacking Toxic Shot ticks plus Ignite's burn; since Remove Scurvy can offset some of that damage, commit to all-ins only after he's already spent W.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and every win-rate or pick-rate figure above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the trade-pattern, cooldown-window, and power-curve reasoning is my own read of the kit, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Gangplank’s Powder Keg(E) placed inside brushes! Close in to deal damage when Powder Keg (E) is on cooldown!
